thesis: Physical and perceptual constraints do not dictate cultural value or one legitimate artistic form.
role: Show creativity within constraints and disclose selection.

ideas.statement: Physical possibility, perceptual effect and aesthetic value differ; a preference does not establish what art ought to maximize.
Generative-art explanations must include initial conditions and selection among attempts, not only a simple rule.
